csv_scope_of_work: The City of Imperial (City) invites qualified consultants to submit proposals for Feasibility, Design, and Engineering Services for the Imperial Regional Park Development Project. The city seeks a skilled, multidisciplinary design and engineering team capable of providing feasibility analysis, master planning, design development, construction documentation, and optional construction-phase support for a 143-acre regional park. The project will serve the City s 22,000 residents and a regional population exceeding 100,000 within 10 miles, emphasizing public accessibility, recreation, and environmental resilience
